title: “A Thousand Countries to Go To”: Peasants and Rulers in Late Eighteenth-Century Bengal
note: Peer-reviewed Past & Present 189(1) article, November 2005, pp. 81–109. It examines peasant and ruler relations in late eighteenth-century Bengal.
whyItMatters: Analyses relations between peasants and rulers in late eighteenth-century Bengal, giving context for the Rangpur uprising and rural resistance.
